name: Dumbbell Push Press
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip by bending your knees slightly, then drive up through your legs and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lock out your arms above your head, then lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with the dumbbells at the shoulders and the knees slightly bent.
